title: Chapter 947
text:
[Divine Throne Mechanic] Lv.1 + 450 Energy, + 5 STR, + 5 DEX, + 15 END, + 20 INT. You have received 15 Free Attribute Points and 1 Potential Point.

You have received the talent [Key of Adeptus Mechanicus]!

You have received the talent [Spiritual Instrument]!

You have received the talent [Mechanical Force Enhancement — Creator's Heart]!

You have learned the ability [Universal Simulation]!

You have learned the ability [Dimension Factory]!

You have learned the ability [Virtual Paramount]!

You have learned the ability [Mechanical Tinder Proliferation]!

You have learned the ability [Mechanical Civilization Enhancement]!

You have learned the ability [Apostle Evolution]!

You have learned the ability [Fusion — Mechanical Deity]!

You have learned the blueprint [Divine Mechanical Throne]!

All of your Virtual Technology skills and talents have their effects increased by 50%.

A series of notifications popped up on the interface, dazzling Han Xiao.

The surging energy spread out again, and with Han Xiao at the center, it formed an enormous tornado. Looking down from space, it looked like a pot of gray soup being stirred.

[Divine Throne Mechanic] was a stage of transformation. The upper limit of [Lord Mechanic] was LV 40, and it jumped to LV 60. From Apostle, Emperor, Lord, and finally Divine Throne!

This was the peak of Mechanics in the explored universe. 'Mecha Empire' Manison was at the stage of [Divine Throne Mechanic]. Among the Beyond Grade As in the world, no one could surpass him for the time being.

At this level, all of his abilities had undergone a transformation.

If the specialty of an Apostle Mechanic was that great power belonged to himself, the specialty of an Emperor Mechanic was the strengthening of the Army Style, and the specialty of a Lord Mechanic was the super long range of the All-Map Style and the ability to enchant Apostle Weapons … then the specialty of a Divine Throne Mechanic was that it had greatly strengthened the foundation of the three and pointed out a new direction.

Han Xiao endured the pain of the transformation and carefully browsed through the interface, looking at the abilities that came with the Class Advancement.

[Key of Adeptus Mechanicus] talent. Its basic effect was to increase Machinery Affinity by 200%. Its core effect was to establish his own Machinery Faith. As long as there were believers worshipping him as the God of Machinery, he would receive feedback. The more believers he had, the stronger the feedback.

There were many religions in the universe, and any Tom, Dick, and Harry could have believers. The Machinery Faith was a special religion in the universe, fanatically worshipping machinery and technology. It was a unity of materialism and idealism, worshipping every powerful Mechanic and worshipping them as the God of Machinery.

Ever since Han Xiao had done so many things, he had actually gained a large number of believers of the Machinery Faith. Now, these believers could receive some feedback from him — believing in a Beyond Grade A Mechanic who had the [Key of Adeptus Mechanicus] could increase their Machinery Affinity.

Manison had always been the main target of worship for the current Machinery Faith, and he had obtained a huge amount of power from his believers. Now, Han Xiao also had the right to obtain power from his believers …

To put it bluntly, this was like harvesting leeks. This was something that Han Technician knew very well!

The [Spirit Instrument] talent increased the success rate of Gold Grade blueprints. If he could create Universal Treasure Gold Grade equipment, he would receive additional bonuses.

In Han Xiao's previous life, there was a saying that was widely spread on the forums that the five Super systems represented the five directions of a true 'god'. The Pugilist system represented the 'body', the Psychic system represented the 'mind', the Mage system represented the 'control of the rules', the Esper system represented the 'supernatural powers', and the Mechanic system represented the 'equipment of the gods'.

Although this saying did not have any theoretical basis, it was indeed very interesting and made one's imagination run wild.

[Mechanical Force Ascension — Creator's Heart] was a core talent that increased Machinery Affinity by 450%, Machinery Production Efficiency by 300%, and Machinery Creation Performance by 40%. Just like [Mechanical Force Ascension — Apostle's Body], this was also an ability that allowed his Mechanical Force attributes to transform.

At the same time, this talent also provided stronger personal attributes. According to the level of all Mechanic skills (including blueprint skills), it would provide Free Attribute Points. A single skill would give one point, Level 7 would give two points, and Level 10 would give three points.

Currently, Han Xiao's official Mechanic skills were all at the maximum level, which provided him 189 Free Attribute Points. He also had thousands of blueprint skills, most of which were obtained through gambling and had not been upgraded. Among them, the blueprints that met the requirements provided him with a total of 2,128 Free Attribute Points, which added up to 2,317 Free Attribute Points.

Although the total was not as good as all his attributes, he could freely add points to them!

Furthermore, compared to the attributes that he would receive during his Promotion, this skill had a very high growth rate. It provided him with a new way to obtain Free Attribute Points. This was a channel for Mechanics to convert knowledge.

Knowledge was power, and the more he learned, the stronger he would be.

Apart from these three talents, the new skills were basically all the cores of [Divine Throne Mechanic].

[Universal Simulation] was not a combat skill but a creation skill. It allowed him to use machinery to simulate the operation of most things, including but not limited to various celestial bodies, natural phenomena, and so on. Other than the limitation of materials, it was like a creator. However, this creator only used machinery.

As for the use of this ability, Han Xiao did not really understand it. According to his guess, this should be an ability that leaned towards living, and to a certain extent, it could jump out of the restrictions of blueprints. Nature was the best source of inspiration. Since ancient times, almost all civilizations that developed naturally had their starting point of technology imitating nature.

[Dimension Factory] had similar functions to the [Secondary Dimension Army] of the Emperor Mechanic. However, the difference was that the Dimension Factory was equivalent to opening up a logistics base in a secondary dimension. During war, the factory could be brought along at any time to collect the abandoned parts on the battlefield and reforge them. It could be used to create and repair machinery endlessly.

The newly created machinery could be used on the battlefield immediately, and targeted equipment could be created on the spot. It was much stronger than the simple [Waste Modification] and [Advanced Machinery Construction], and its endurance was greatly increased.

With the [Dimension Factory], the Lord Mechanic's all-map fighting style would become complete. He would not have to worry about not having enough logistical support no matter where he went.

[Virtual Paramount] was an ability that came from the Virtual Profession.

If he had chosen the Armed Branch as his Profession, the activated skill would be [Sky Dome Structure]. If he had chosen the Energy Branch, the activated skill would be [Energy Plasticity].

The basic effect of [Virtual Paramount] was a 200% increase in Virtual Technology, and all Virtual Skills + 3 by default. Its core function was to open up a Virtual World and occupy a place in the quantum network. Only Virtual Lifeforms and their own Virtual Souls could enter.

It had many uses. It could be used as a breeding ground for Virtual Lifeforms to evolve nature. It could also be used as a fortress in the quantum network, releasing a large number of special AI hunters to hunt for information in the quantum network, intercepting data or spreading viruses. When using [Virtual Soul] to virtualize the target's soul, it could also trap the target in this Virtual World. Compared to the quantum network, the target's escape time would be greatly extended, and forcefully escaping would cause greater mental damage.

Han Xiao felt that Manison had relied on this ability to enslave the AI civilization.

[Mechanical Tinder Proliferation] and [Machinery Civilization Strengthening] were both talents that strengthened Mechanical Lifeforms. The former increased the efficiency of one's transformation into Mechanical Lifeforms, increasing the effect of [Tinder Awakening]. The latter strengthened one's subordinate Mechanical Lifeforms in many ways.

The aspects of strengthening included reducing the tinder energy consumed by the Mechanical Lifeforms to reproduce, increasing the potential of the Mechanical Lifeforms, increasing the speed of reproduction, and so on.

These two abilities played a huge role in the Mecha Empire's accumulation of a huge Mechanical Civilization army.

[Apostle Evolution] strengthened the effect of the Lord Mechanic's [Apostle Life Creation]. It did not increase the number of Apostle Weapons, but it increased the strengthening effect of the Apostle Weapons, allowing the Apostle Weapons to have greater combat strength.

[Fusion — Mechanical Deity] was a transformation ability. With the main body or the Lord's Avatar as the core, the scattered Mech Legion would be merged into one, forming an extremely huge Mechanical Construct. It would become an extension of one's own body, controlling this super big guy to fight.

As long as there were enough Mech Legion, it was not impossible for it to reach the size of a planet. This was a different kind of planetary construction project.

This big guy had all the functions of the Fusion Machinery, and its attributes were extremely terrifying.

It could traverse the universe with its huge body. This was the 'Mechanical Deity'!

The last blueprint, [Divine Mechanical Throne], was a special equipment. It was a floating Mechanical Throne, similar to the one Han Xiao had created in the past.

However, this one had a special effect. Sitting on it could increase one's Machinery Affinity, obtaining a 1.1x increase in Machinery Affinity. Therefore, it was not unreasonable for some Beyond Grade As to like the Mechanical Throne. Of course, most of it was for the sake of being cool.

The number of skills he obtained during this Class Advancement might be the most in history. It was enough to show how terrifying the [Divine Throne Mechanic] stage was.

"The increase in my strength this time is too great!"

Even though the Class Advancement process was not over, this bit of pain was unable to suppress Han Xiao's excitement.

After completing the level 300 Promotion and Class Advancement, he had truly stepped onto the level of EsGod, the Mecha Empire, and the Dark Emperor!
